cba.banner_text: Every 2027 figure is a 2022 CBA carry-forward: the agreement expires 2026-12-01 and no threshold, league minimum, arbitration structure or qualifying-offer value past it has been published. Where Spotrac uses a different 2027 basis the page prints both, each labelled.

copy.masthead: Every dollar a club has on the books, from Spotrac and the platform's own models, with what each dollar is projected to buy. No revenue, no valuations, no TV money: nothing here says what a club earns.
copy.league_lede: Thirty clubs on two Spotrac bases and the platform's own prices. Only Cost+ and OrgSur+ take a colour; every dollar cell prints plain, and the league average row is a reference, never a club.
copy.club_foot: Descriptive ledger. No single projected payroll is served: contract dollars on file, projected arbitration steps and rule minimums are three keys the page never sums.
copy.cba_banner: Every 2027 figure is a 2022 CBA carry-forward: the agreement expires 2026-12-01 and no threshold, league minimum, arbitration structure or qualifying-offer value past it has been published. Where Spotrac uses a different 2027 basis the page prints both, each labelled.
copy.cbt_computed_label: computed from Spotrac tax payroll and the 2022 CBA schedule (cba_rules.json)
copy.cbt_clock_rule: the rate resets to first-time after one full season under the threshold; rule text, not a forecast
copy.cbt_verify_note: every cba_rules record is curated-unverified; the 2027 threshold is explicitly unknown
copy.qo_recipient_note: which clubs receive revenue sharing is not sourceable here; that QO pick tax tier is a league value only
copy.split_2026_note: the 2026 Spotrac payroll page carries no active / injured / retained / buried split; the strip is drawn for 2027 only
copy.allocations_note: CBT payroll is Spotrac's AAV basis; total payroll allocations are Spotrac's cash basis
copy.history_blocked_on: Payroll history is cached but not yet ingested (fa_team_payroll holds 2026-2027); the cache-only backfill of the 2016-2025 Spotrac pages has not run

commitments_bases.contract: Contract dollars on file (Spotrac, never re-priced)
commitments_bases.prearb: Pre-arb minimums by rule (780,000 per PRE-ARB season, salary_path.LEAGUE_MIN_CURATED[2026] carried forward)

copy.commitments_not_summed: three labelled segments and a count of unpriced vets; no key sums them into a payroll, because that sum would be a forecast without a registry row
copy.horizon_label: half of today's contract dollars roll off by
copy.expiring_basis: fa_class members from this club; projected guarantees are sums of means and the P10-P90 band is shown per player in the free agency block
holes: every 2027+ arbitration step is a 2022 CBA carry-forward past the 2026-12-01 expiry, and no interval covers that
the class token is inferred rather than read from published service time on most board rows, and class closure uses it twice, once for the rung and once for the horizon
arb-2+ is a served null (an empirical step multiplier beat the model), and closure runs that same multiplier one to two rungs further
window length is a property of Spotrac's grid depth, so two comparable players can carry two and four priced seasons for no baseball reason
copy.options_note: Options on file (curated: salPath option stamps, contract_options.json and the trade board's Spotrac years); Spotrac years_remaining omits them.
copy.deferral_rate_label: NPV at the platform 7 pct rate
copy.deferral_coverage: covered deals only: every guarantee of 200M or more has an entry (audited into fa_gate2_eval.deferral_coverage); this is not a complete club deferral ledger
copy.deferral_rate_note: the platform discounts at 7 pct, which differs from the CBT statutory rate, so these NPVs read lower than league-reported figures
copy.dead_money_blocked_on: Spotrac's dataTable-dead rows carry no table_id on the read side yet (spotrac._parse_team_contract_table); the tag trails v1 so the priced contract set cannot widen by accident
copy.dead_money_beside: Spotrac 2027 buried allocation, a different table with an overlapping definition; never summed with dead money
copy.retained_blocked_on: Spotrac's dataTable-retained rows carry no table_id on the read side yet; retained obligations are never merged into the employing club's AAV
copy.arb_upper_bound: Upper bound, not a payroll forecast: non-tenders and extensions are absent
copy.arb_provisional: provisional: the arb-1 model is gated, arb-2+ is a population multiplier
copy.arb_flag_key: flag bits: 1 step not from published service time, 2 step from the debut heuristic, 4 no salary on file, 8 past the CBA expiry, 16 2020 prorated
copy.arb_realized_title: What arbitration cost, and what it bought
copy.arb_realized_copy: Realized value, not skill: what arbitration paid and what the seasons returned. The counterfactual, what the club would have paid had it settled or gone to a hearing differently, is not observed.
copy.ou_mkt: actual minus OUR model: what the arbitration system paid relative to comparable players. Sums to roughly zero by construction.
copy.ou_war: actual minus WAR (eWAR basis) priced at that season's dollars per win. Does NOT sum to zero, because arbitration systematically pays below the open market.
copy.never_combine: The two residuals answer different questions and are never averaged or summed. No combined column exists and none may be added.
copy.surplus_basis: MLB leg: MLB Projections surNpv at dpw 17,971,003 (2027 ex-ante), 5-season horizon, 7 pct discount, usd converted to $M; farm leg: org_summary active surplus ($M, prospect_surplus validated). Both legs in $M before the sum.
copy.surplus_no_tier: a club total sits above the player-row surplus ladder's top cut nearly everywhere, so it prints plain
copy.surplus_ev: Sur+ sums are sums of expected values; quantiles are never summed
copy.trade_currency_basis: Trade Machine currency (trade_machine_surplus provisional); overlaps the MLB and farm legs by construction and is never added to them
copy.trajectory_note: since late June, no earlier history
copy.cost_plus_basis: descriptive index: a ratio of two served numbers, not a model
copy.cost_plus_registry: no registry row: Cost+ predicts nothing; a skill claim would need an eval first

fin_contract_surplus.basis: usd per year: current AAV minus bonus amortized over six years, graduates

fin_draft_pool_efficiency.basis: WAR per $M of draft pool in window

fin_ifa_roi.basis: WAR per $M of IFA bonus, eight-season window

copy.farm_letters_note: letters come from org_summary.grades (rank across 30 orgs) and are never recomputed; a sparse leaf prints a dash
copy.pools_note: 2021 holds nine clubs (parser miss on the MLB.com article); 2027 pools are not published
copy.slot_coverage_basis: share of the league's draft_results rows for that year carrying slot_usd
copy.pick_war_label: expected first-6 WAR of the 2027 first-round pick (draft_slot_curve, validated; on the projected slot, not lottery-weighted)
copy.pick_war_why: the lottery snapshot carries the odds of pick 1 and of a top-6 pick, not the full odds vector, so the expectation is on the projected slot
copy.pick_dollars: pick dollars are not served: the only in-repo pick pricing is the QO tax method
copy.ifa_implied_basis: implied from Spotrac pool percentages, not a published allocation
copy.ifa_history_blocked_on: IFA classes 2009-2018 are cached but run_monthly caps the range at 2021; extending it is a cache-only ingest deferred past v1, and 2019-2020 pages are not on disk
copy.fits_note: fa_team_fit is provisional: gate-3 MRR .165 against random .133
copy.implied_dpw_note: the club's implied dollars per WAR is not on the archive rows (projected WAR at signing is not stored), so only the league rate prints
copy.realized_title: Contract value delivered (realized, elapsed seasons only)
copy.realized_sentence: This is what the contracts returned, not how well the club chose them. The counterfactual, what the same dollars would have bought elsewhere that winter, is not observed, so no club is ranked by it.
copy.realized_coverage: covered signings carry the realized block; the current winter carries none because no season has elapsed
copy.realized_not_skill: Realized value, not skill: what happened after the money was spent, with the counterfactual unobserved.
copy.no_payroll_line: A single projected payroll is not served: it would need registry row club_payroll_path and the 2016-2025 payroll history as labels.
copy.load_error: The Club Ledger could not be loaded.
copy.arb_dpw_basis: arbitration dollars per WAR 2026 (arbitration.json dpw) over the open-market rate for winter 2026 (fa_dpw_series)
copy.projections_dpw_basis: mlb_projections dpw_usd, 2027 ex-ante, the surplus pricing rate
copy.league_minimum_note: salary_path.LEAGUE_MIN_CURATED; seasons past 2026 carry the last value forward by rule

war_input_divergence.pinned_off: F-DEF, the fitted defensive and positional column
war_input_divergence.why: F-DEF wins the WAR projection gate and loses the money gate. Dropped from pricing only: AAV error 3.135 to 2.909 (about 2.5x the smallest resolvable difference), edge over baseline 0.224 to 0.340, guarantee and mega-deal error also lower.
war_input_divergence.consequence: FA prices here use a WAR projection without defense. MLB Projections includes it, so the two can show different WAR for one player.
